dedupe_keys.name: bundesweite straßenverkehrszahlung 2025 svz german five yearly federal road traffic census

description: The nationwide road traffic census (SVZ) is carried out every five years for the Federal Ministry of Transport at about 40,000 counting points across Germany, to provide traffic volumes and other parameters for every section of the federal trunk road network and to derive annual figures. Autobahn GmbH and the state road administrations count at more than 12,500 points on motorways and federal roads and about 27,500 on the subordinate network. The 2025 census again uses three methods: permanent automatic counters with induction loops that classify each vehicle anonymously into eight types and give hourly data all year, temporary side-radar measurements to densify the network, and manual counts. Coverage: federal, state and district roads in Germany. Format and access: results are published after processing. Licence and cost: free; no licence is stated on the page. Caveats: the 2025 page describes the survey; results appear later. It supports network flow and capacity planning of German roads. It relates to the BASt permanent counters and the German hourly truck flows in the catalogue.
